touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small Kemnay-edge locality whose restored quarry ponds support a local walk and birdwatching stop, but not a complete town visit.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Public outdoor routes can form part of a dog visit, with ordinary close-control restrictions around roads, wildlife and shared spaces.

visitorHighlights.name: Dalmadilly Ponds
visitorHighlights.reason: Restored former quarry ponds with paths, bird habitat and birdwatching interest, also identified on the council’s Kemnay walking map.
visitorHighlights.tagline: Wildlife ponds and quiet local paths
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Outdoor paths are generally accessible; bird-hide access is separately controlled and should be checked locally
visitorHighlights.admission: Free; no staffed visitor facilities claimed
